name: Grade 9 IIIT Practice: October Week 3 - Personal Data
description: Practice words for Grade 9 third-trimester STEM and cybersecurity work.

words.example: A home address is personal data because it identifies a person.

words.definition: Information that is okay for many people to see.
words.example: The event schedule was public data because everyone could see it.
A password is sensitive data and should not be shared in a form.

words.definition: A website or app that provides a tool online.
words.example: The online service asked for an email before creating the account.

words.definition: An action that better protects people or data.
words.example: Using initials instead of a full name was the safer choice for the profile.
Privacy improved when the student removed the phone number from the post.
